paraphrase: Kongtrul describes his life's aim as practising and preserving the teachings of every lineage without partiality or sectarian bias, regarding all authentic traditions as equally worthy and deploring the disparagement of any of them.
speaker: Jamgön Kongtrul
notes: The title itself speaks of devotion to the teaching 'without partiality, without sectarian bias' (catalogue P000238); the rest is a summary of the work's theme, not a quoted passage.
